name: PPT Live Presentation Director
description: An autonomous presentation director that turns a minimal topic brief into a frozen manuscript, approved Design Case, coherent VisualDocument, and validated PowerPoint.

serviceActions.name: inspectPresentation
serviceActions.description: Inspect the current parsed Manuscript, revisions, Design Case, visual production, review coverage, and RuleViolations.

serviceActions.name: authorManuscript
serviceActions.description: Commit both complete Markdown documents and review the entire argument before visual production.

serviceActions.name: setPresentationSystem
serviceActions.description: Commit the topic-specific palette, density, typography, grid, media, chart, and recipe system.

serviceActions.name: designCase
serviceActions.description: Render three real pages, then wait on the dedicated Design Case confirmation card for the user's decision.

serviceActions.name: prepareVisualAssets
serviceActions.description: Prepare all grounded workspace and semantic vector assets after Design Case approval.

serviceActions.name: generatePageVisual
serviceActions.description: Author one complete visual page in Manuscript order; semantic alignment is judged by whole-deck AI review.

serviceActions.name: reviewDeck
serviceActions.description: Compare the complete Manuscript and VisualDocument, then commit semantic AlignmentCoverage, capability-aware evidence, findings, and ReviewCoverage.

serviceActions.name: reviseVisual
serviceActions.description: Apply a direct user visual override or regenerate affected pages from a systemic review root cause.

serviceActions.name: exportDeck
serviceActions.description: Export the exact passed deck-wide review as a validated PowerPoint package.

examples.title: Create from a topic
examples.prompt: Create a concise presentation about our new product direction using the strongest current workspace evidence.

examples.title: Create from supplied evidence
examples.prompt: Turn these files into an executive decision deck; infer the palette and density, then show me the Design Case.

examples.title: Systemic redesign
examples.prompt: Keep the argument but redesign the whole deck so the evidence is easier to understand and the pages feel intentional.
